## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle Sòng-period Esoteric ritual manual translated by **Dānapāla** ([施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7)). The text gives the *yíguǐ* (ritual procedure) for the deity-system of the **Highest-Esoteric Great-Teaching-King** doctrine, with the principal mantras and their *míngyì* (names-and-meanings).

**Abstract**

The work is a working Esoteric ritual manual paired with [KR6j0055](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0055) (the *Wúèr píngděng zuìshàng yújiā dàjiàowáng jīng*) — a *yíguǐ* (ritual codification) accompanying the doctrinal *yoga-uttara-tantra* scripture. The two-fascicle structure covers preparatory rites and central *sādhana* sequence.

The translation dates from Dānapāla's career at the Sòng Yìjīngyuàn (982–1017).
